introduction: Child Health Plus provides health coverage for eligible New York children younger than19 who are not eligible for Medicaid.
description: Child Health Plus provides health coverage for eligible New York children younger than19 who are not eligible for Medicaid.

sections.who: Residency, existing coverage and other program rules apply. Income affects premiums; ask about current immigration and coverage conditions.
sections.get: The program provides child health coverage. Premium requirements depend on the approved category.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Apply through NY State of Health

    Use the state application guidance or call855-355-5777.

  2. Find an enroller

    Free community assistance can help with the application.

  3. Complete enrollment

    Review plan and premium instructions and provide requested proof.
sections.after: Follow current renewal notices. Older claims of continuous coverage through age6 should not replace current rules.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Child Health Plus applying; Eligibility; Current child coverage notice. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Does the application also check Medicaid?
Ask the enroller to screen the child’s coverage options.
Are premiums identical for all families?
Can I assume no renewal until age6?
No. NYC311 says that continuous-coverage policy endedJuly1,2026.
